title: Marker Interface Pattern
overview: Use an empty interface to tag classes and allow runtime type checking without adding methods.
useCases: You want to mark classes as having a capability without requiring them to implement methods
Classes can be grouped into categories checked at runtime via instanceof
You want to apply cross-cutting behaviour (e.g. serialisation, cloning) to specific classes without polluting their API
exampleUses: Java's Serializable interface tags classes as safe to serialise without adding any serialisation methods to them
Marking certain domain events as AuditableEvent so an audit framework can intercept and log them automatically
Tagging entity classes as Cacheable so an ORM layer knows which ones are safe to store in a second-level cache
